title: Welcome to the Santa Susana Knolls
intro:
The Knolls is a rural neighborhood in the hills at the foot of the Santa Susana Mountains, on the Simi Valley side, in unincorporated Ventura County. Our streets wind around oak-covered hills and sandstone boulders, and you can still spot roadrunners, quail and red-tailed hawks on an evening walk.

This is the website of the Santa Susana Knolls Homeowners Association. Here you'll find meeting dates, your HOA board, and phone numbers for local services.
